desks.headline: Kartik's 83 wins the week; Rajat Arora stays top
desks.text: **Kartik** won the week with **83 points**, 21 above the league average of 62. Rajat Arora keeps top spot on 734, with a lead of **18** over Neol after a 70-point week. Sahil's climb from 42nd to 18th, with 82 points, was the other big story.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks on 76 armbands; Kartik wins the week
desks.text: **Kartik** won the week with **83 points**, while Haaland's blank wasted **76 armbands** across the league. Rajat Arora keeps top spot on 734, with an 18-point lead over Neol. Sahil climbed from 42nd to 19th with the week's second-best score, a leap that reshuffled the chasing pack.
